statement_map.email_excerpt: Leads were arriving from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.
Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, then submitted a test form from another email address and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.
We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is advisable, and that you can do this in the email domain part of the settings.
Verify your sender domain (you mentioned you would do this tomorrow morning).
